Every AI sentence in the sample, with its verdicts

Companion page to The Boilerplate Decade. 2,242 sentences from 315 annual reports filed 2015 to 2026 that mention artificial intelligence, each rated twice blind, a third time where the two passes disagreed, and scored for how many other registrants have filed the same 12-word phrase. Sentences removed by the term audit (the letters AI inside a company name) are shown greyed. Source: SEC EDGAR, public domain.

10-Ks mentioning AI: 0.5% in 2015, 49.2% in 2025Repository: github.com/ishaanshah101/ai-disclosure-trend-audit
